title: Dick Cheney at the top of the secrecy pyramid
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Dick Cheney at the top of the secrecy pyramid, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and I said to him who among all the people in society is keeping this secret who sits a top the Pyramid of classified information he said Dick Cheney

you know a buddy of mine Walter Kern you know I introduced him to David Grush. He's a journalist. He came out saying, you know, uh, Grush told him that Cheney was the gate the the gatekeeper for all legacy UFO programs.
tellings.difference: Calls Cheney the gatekeeper of all legacy UFO programs and notes that Michels introduced Kirn to Grusch.
tellings.link_reason: The same account: Grusch told Walter Kirn that Cheney sits at the top of, or guards, the UFO secrecy.

as_told.title: Grusch told Walter Kirn that Cheney was gatekeeper of the legacy UFO programs

tellings.quote: that what did Walter Kern say? That Dave Grush told him that uh Dick Cheney was the head of the UFO pyramid for quite a while.
tellings.difference: Adds that Cheney held the role 'for quite a while', up to about 2009.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Grusch told Walter Kirn that Dick Cheney sat atop the pyramid of UFO secrecy.

as_told.title: Grusch told Walter Kirn that Dick Cheney headed the UFO pyramid

tellings.quote: Modern UFO whistleblower David Grush has suggested that someone like former vice president Dick Cheney was a gatekeeper of the UFO program.
tellings.difference: Leaves out Walter Kirn as the go-between, hedges the claim as 'someone like' Cheney, and calls Grusch a modern UFO whistleblower.
tellings.link_reason: The same claim as the story: Grusch named Dick Cheney as the gatekeeper of the legacy UFO programs, which Walter Kirn relays in the story's tellings.

as_told.title: Grusch suggests Dick Cheney was a UFO program gatekeeper

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says he introduced a journalist friend, Walter Kirn, to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who became a UFO whistleblower. According to Kirn, when he asked Grusch who sits at the very top of the pyramid of secret information, Grusch said Dick Cheney, the former US vice president. Michels describes Cheney as the gatekeeper of all the long-running secret UFO programs, and a researcher known as UAPGerb adds that he held that role for quite a while. If true, it would put one of America's most powerful officials in charge of the biggest secret of all.
